source: STEER Project (Save the Children, iDE Cambodia, and the Cambodian Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries) - "Guide on Banana Cultivation Techniques" (សៀវភៅណែនាំស្តីអំពី បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះដំណាំចេក), February 2020
text:
Leaf-roller caterpillars fold or roll sections of the banana leaf and feed inside the shelter this creates, leaving visible chewed leaf tissue and rolled leaf sections; heavy infestation reduces the leaf area available for photosynthesis. A stem-boring weevil separately tunnels into the pseudostem, and its larvae can be found inside damaged stem tissue.

Where infestation is significant, the guide lists insecticide options for these pests including chlorpyrifos, abamectin, emamectin benzoate, and chlorfenapyr, applied according to label directions; as with other pests, removing and destroying heavily infested plant material helps limit spread.
